name: Mesa de amigos — refinamento
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Edit image 1, the selected RachaConta two-screen Android concept. Image 2 is a furniture reference ONLY: a square yellow molded-plastic Brazilian boteco table with matching plastic armchairs. Keep image 1's welcoming cream, terracotta and green identity and two-screen product flow, while making it visibly cleaner and lighter.

Maintain two complete portrait app screens side by side, each representing 390 x 844 logical pixels, app content edge to edge. Remove ALL handwritten peripheral sayings, accent scribbles, paper notes, extra decorative captions, the wooden table, and the faded chair/table behind the result heading. Replace the oversized framed sign with a smaller unframed RachaConta hand-lettered wordmark. Preserve “Bora rachar?” in a calmer medium weight. Change heavy near-black green type to lighter muted sage/olive green; secondary text uses a readable warm olive. Lighten font color and weight without making essential labels or amounts faint. Use a clean flat pale-cream background, no grain. Keep terracotta primary button with white readable text.

Use exactly ONE modest illustrated footer scene on the FORM screen: the yellow square plastic table and matching chairs from image 2, translated into the original warm painterly style, compact and gently cropped at the bottom. Plain tabletop and chairs, NO beverage logos, lettering, floor, bottles or advertising. Keep all controls above it. The RESULT screen has no illustration, just generous whitespace.

Preserve working UI content: form “Valor da conta” R$100,00; “Pessoas” minus 3 plus; “Serviço opcional” switch OFF and inactive 10%; helper “Só se ainda não estiver na conta.”; “Nome do encontro (opcional)” Pizza de sexta; “Calcular divisão”; make “Usar exemplo” a quiet text action. Result back arrow, “Resultado”, “Pizza de sexta”, “Divisão por pessoa”; aligned rows “2 pessoas · R$ 33,33” and “1 pessoa · R$ 33,34”; “Os centavos fecham o total.”; Conta R$100,00, Serviço R$0,00, Total R$100,00; switch OFF “Incluir serviço de 10%”; “Editar conta”. Fewer boxes: flat payout rows separated by a subtle rule. Familiar Android controls, 48dp touch targets, body 14–16sp. No device frame or OS bars. No extra features.
